In NRS 202.265 subsection 1, the sentence adding 'public library' to the covered property runs across struck text, so it is not quoted; the quoted list item (f) is the firearm line of that ban. operative_text:
Section 1 (NRS 202.265): (f) A pistol, revolver or other firearm; or
Section 1 (NRS 202.265): Any person who violates subsection 1 is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.
Section 1 (NRS 202.265): This section does not prohibit the possession of a weapon listed in subsection 1 on the property of:
Section 1 (NRS 202.265): “Public library” has the meaning ascribed to it in NRS 379.0057.
Section 2 (NRS 202.3673): A public building that is located on the property of a public school , a public library or a child care facility or the property of the Nevada System of Higher Education, unless the permittee has obtained written permission to carry a concealed firearm while he or she is on the premises of the public building pursuant to subparagraph (3) of paragraph (a) of subsection 3 of NRS 202.265.
Section 2 (NRS 202.3673): A person who violates subsection 2 or 3 is guilty of a misdemeanor.
